meta.name: ecommerce-copywriter
meta.description: 电商图片文案创作技能，支持多品类产品的吸引性文案生成，适用于电商平台的商品营销推广

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 为电商商品生成吸引人的营销文案
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要为电商产品快速撰写吸引眼球的文案
copy.tagline_en: Generate compelling marketing copy for ecommerce products
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to quickly write eye-catching copy for ecommerce products

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 能根据产品信息生成电商图片文案，包括标题、正文和 emoji，也能优化已有文案。文案结构固定：痛点引入、产品介绍、卖点阐述、情感升华。
howto.when: 当用户提出电商文案创作或优化需求时触发，例如要求为某商品写营销文案。

say.text: 帮我为这款智能眼罩写一段电商文案。
say.note: Claude 会收集产品信息并生成完整文案。

say.text: 优化这段充电宝文案，让标题更吸引人。
say.note: Claude 会分析并改进标题、正文和 emoji。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can generate e-commerce image copy including headlines, body text, and emoji based on product info, and also optimize existing copy. The copy follows a fixed structure: pain point introduction, product introduction, selling points, and emotional call to action.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user requests e-commerce copywriting or optimization, e.g., asking to write marketing copy for a product.

say_en.text: Write an e-commerce copy for this smart sleep mask.
say_en.note: Claude will collect product info and generate full copy.

say_en.text: Optimize this power bank copy to make the headline more attractive.
say_en.note: Claude will analyze and improve headline, body, and emoji.
